body: ac-00 re-baseline (2026-06-18, /tmp/finetype-instr current-model rhh-instrumentation build, pre-cardinality-guard; manifest 338 scored rows): the identity gap PERSISTS. Baseline 290/338 correct (0.858). Disabling substring_matcher_identity: 8 label changes, 290->282 correct -> ALL 8 hint columns go correct->wrong, so learned-model no_hint identity accuracy = 0/8 = 0.000, essentially unchanged from April's 0/9 (v19). Identity is the WORST header-hint family to remove (others net: same_category 0, generic -2, cross_domain -3, header_hint_table -5). NUANCE: the 8 eval columns are cases where the hint is RIGHT (real-name columns) -> this measures DELETABILITY blocker (can't delete without regressing real names), NOT the handle->username upside (curated manifest has no Author-handle columns; that's measured on gold/corpus/representative). So the retrain has two jobs: (1) lift no_hint identity 0/8 -> >=80% on real-name cols (ac-04 ablation gate, makes hint deletable); (2) fix handle->username (gold/corpus). CAVEATS: pre-guard binary; ac04 crashed writing the TSV (path bug: relative_to fails when --binary is outside repo root -- fix: copy binary into repo or patch ac04 line 391) so only aggregate counts captured, not per-column detail (regenerate for ac-01 hard-negative design). FOLLOW-UP: fix ac04 path bug; the RHH inventory line numbers are stale (column.rs -> column/mod.rs split) but family_ids + kill switches valid.

ac-02 in progress: extract_identity_hard_negatives.py built + verified. From 183,113 author/login-headed corpus cols: 107,446 HANDLE->username available, 8,816 MULTITOKEN->full_name; emitted 1,800 username + 900 full_name (capped, even-stride), ZERO leakage collisions vs eval/row_hashes.tsv. Labels spot-checked sane (username: goodmike/far33d/dfens handles; full_name: Emily Dickinson, author lists). Output output/identity-fortification/identity_hard_negatives.parquet (gitignored). MINIMAL-FIRST composition: username positives + full_name only, NO hand-labelled hard negatives this cycle — the drift proxy decides if username over-emits; add counterweights only if NO-GO. REMAINING ac-02: fold the parquet into the distilled blend, build FTMB (prepare_multibranch_data.py, v24 recipe), run proxy_pretrain.sh + drift_report.py (multi-hour). On proxy GO -> overnight train (ac-03).

ac-02 proxy debugging (2026-06-18): the 10-epoch proxy trained clean (val_acc 88.31%) but hit THREE instrument issues before a valid read. (1) Duplicate FTMB build from a bad liveness check (killed, no corruption). (2) snapshot_sense_distribution.py BROKE post-choice-0100: it converts parquet->CSV then reprofiles, but the strict duckdb CSV reader (ignore_errors=false) aborts the whole batch on one text-heavy converted CSV, capturing only 1 file/3 cols -> bogus drift (99x ratios). FIXED: profile source parquets DIRECTLY (profile reads parquet natively post-0100; batch mode is tolerant, 995/1000 exit 0). (3) Method confound: stored baseline sense_dist_v19fx_s42.json is OLD CSV-method; regenerated a parquet-method full-v19 baseline (output/destination-drift-precheck/sense_dist_v19_parquet.json) for apples-to-apples. METHOD-MATCHED 10ep DRIFT: ONLY user_agent trips (+3.77pp/12.4x), and it is the UNDERTRAINED proxy dumping generic long-text cols (Content/text/dictionary-definitions) into user_agent (plain_text -3.04, comma_separated 399->4 collapse confirm long-text undertraining) -- NOT identity drift. Identity labels IN-BAND: username +0.10pp, full_name +0.53pp (targeted lift landed, no explosion). Author approved a 25-epoch re-proxy to confirm long-text converges while identity stays in-band (running: identity-fortify-proxy25). proxy trains FROM SCRATCH so 10ep undertrains long-text vs full v19; the calibration bands were set on full-vs-full seed noise, so a 10ep proxy can false-NO-GO on undertrained untargeted classes.

ac-02 GO (2026-06-18). 25-epoch re-proxy (val_acc 90.2%) vs parquet-method full-v19 baseline: VERDICT GO, no label beyond band. user_agent CONVERGED (10ep +3.77pp/12.4x NO-GO -> 25ep within band) confirming the 10ep NO-GO was long-text undertraining, NOT identity drift. Identity in-band: username +0.12pp/1.31x, full_name +1.23pp/1.43x. ac-03 LAUNCHED: overnight_identity_fortify.sh, 3 seeds x 50ep on identity-blend.ftmb, tmux session identity-train (pid training seed 42), ~7h. Training-only (no duckdb needed). ENV FIX: duckdb had dropped off PATH mid-session (relocated to ~/.duckdb/cli/1.5.3); symlinked to ~/.local/bin/duckdb (on PATH for all jobs) so tomorrow's gold+corpus gates resolve it. NEXT (awake): pick best seed by val_acc; ac-04 gold(--reframe)+author-relocation gate; ac-05 corpus-honest (--fill-ydf both passes); ac-06 retarget author arm + retire veto.

ac-04 NO-GO (2026-06-18, same-binary gold --reframe): s44 (best seed, val_acc 0.9162) REGRESSED gold vs v19. v19=739/927=0.797 (full_name 6 preds, P0.167); s44=726/927=0.783 (full_name 15 preds, P0.067). -13 columns, driven by full_name OVER-EMISSION: the 900 multi-token full_name additions (author-lists) broadened full_name onto multi-word text (longName x5, ObjectName, name, food_category, County, place/org names). Gold's 1 username col stayed unrecovered (0/1 both). The retrain did NOT beat the deterministic veto; it made the headline worse. KEY LESSON: drift proxy passed (full_name +1.23pp in-band) but gold NO-GO'd -- the proxy measures DISTRIBUTION drift not CORRECTNESS; a small full_name increase landing entirely on the hard place/org gold columns is within-band but precision-killing. Gate hierarchy worked as designed (proxy GO -> gold NO-GO). DECISION: do NOT promote s44; ac-05 corpus-honest is moot (gold already blocks). Models kept as artifacts (models/sherlock-identity-fortify-relu-s{42,43,44}). The bet's composition backfired: additive identity training broadened the full_name catch-all (same failure shape as categorical/numeric_code attractor-broadening). RECOMPOSE OPTION (author's call, ~7h): retrain with username handle positives ONLY (drop the 900 full_name multi-token additions) + hard negatives against place/org full_name. But this is now the 6th retrain to regress; the deterministic veto + the ~0.80 ceiling may be the honest answer.
